I told Marcus in his #north-team thread that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is 25 November. Ilse posted that date in #north-team on 14 October, and nothing in the channel has changed it since.

Marcus is a member of #north-team, so he could already see Ilse's message. A renewal date is an account fact, not a finance figure, so sharing it with the North team is fine.

I haven't checked the date against the contract. It rests only on what Ilse posted, and I said so in the reply.
